falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,800 on any single day within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A breakdown below the August 2024 lows would invalidate the 78% pattern match to bottom_2024_aug, as that bottom held at ~4,800; this would signal the structure has failed and we're in a different regime than the 2024 bottoming pattern

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for 2 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The August 2024 bottom featured VIX peaking near 28-30; sustained VIX above 35 would indicate panic exceeding that bottom's character, proving this is not a similar accumulation phase but rather a more severe liquidation event

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y-2Y Treasury yield curve un-inverts (10Y yield > 2Y yield by >10bps) and holds for 3+ days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The August 2024 bottom occurred with curve deeply inverted; a sustained un-inversion would signal recession realization rather than soft-landing bottoming, invalidating the cyclical bottom pattern match

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
